labelChirho: visit, look upon (with care or concern)
descriptionChirho: To visit someone in need or to look upon with gracious concern, used of God visiting his people in redemption (Luke 1:68, 78; 7:16), visiting the sick or imprisoned (Matt 25:36, 43), and purposeful visits to brethren (Acts 15:36).
To look over and select suitable persons for a task, as when the apostles directed the community to choose seven men for service (Acts 6:3).
